title: Carbon Language Successor Strategy: From C++ Interop to Memory Safety - Chandler Carruth - CppNow 23
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppNow 2023 talk describes Carbon as a successor language to C++ rather than a superset, focusing on C++ interop and a path to memory safety in large existing codebases. It explains why Carbon takes a different approach from Cpp2 and Circle.
why: HN cites it as the authoritative statement of Carbon's memory safety plans, including its borrow-checker-like direction.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
